classification: pending root strategic review; no source finding classified here
scope: Minimal Evolution inventory observation guard and adapter unit coverage only.
authority: Preparation-only delegation. This proposal grants no implementation authority. Approved TODO and CP1 sources remain frozen during the validator and independent review.
observed_issue: consultarInstancia currently maps successful non-array JSON to an empty array. chamar() maps successful JSON parse failures to {}. Thus invalid object/null/string or invalid JSON becomes null (apparent absence); cleanup callers may then mark CLEANED. This behavior predates the Instagram feature and is not asserted as a new regression or classified as a defect in this proposal.

proposed_behavior.valid_absence: Only a valid array inventory with well-formed rows and no exact target name returns null; [] and valid nonmatching rows remain conclusive absence.
proposed_behavior.malformed_or_ambiguous: Non-array payloads, invalid JSON (normalized to {} by current transport helper), malformed rows/optional fields, and duplicate exact target names throw the existing safe EvolutionIndisponivelError.
proposed_behavior.known_observation: A unique exact-name row retains the existing projection: name plus ownerJid and connectionStatus as string or null.
proposed_behavior.transport_and_scope: No new HTTP call or probing path. No change to status/transport outcomes, sends, auth, URLs, secrets, timeouts, or signatures. No fallback is introduced.

unit_cases_in_proposed_diff: invalid JSON rejects after existing {} normalization
valid unique matching row preserves exact observation
required_product_path_regression_case_if: Add service-level coverage in the already-admitted Instagram feature spec: seed an admitted Instagram create/renew pairing flow with a managed prior identity in CLEANUP_PENDING, have the existing consultarInstancia observation receive a successful malformed inventory (plus an invalid-JSON case if coverage permits), then assert the product result remains cleanup-ambiguous, the prior identity remains CLEANUP_PENDING, and Evolution createInstancia is called zero times. Cover both recovery of an existing pending cleanup and the completePairing prior-resource cleanup path if both are reached by the admitted feature flow. A subsequent valid [] inventory should remain the only absence case that can proceed as absence. No separate HTTP probe or parallel domain path.
